row: Learn to safely use essential oils to help your pets live their best life. Dr. Janet Roark has dedicated her life to helping people and their animals. Though she is recognized worldwide as the Essential Oil Vet, she is here to serve. As one of her clients shared, "Dr. Janet is amazing, compassionate, knowledgeable, caring and such a great problem solver when it comes to naturally taking care of animals." Download a copy of her FREE guide, Essential Oils and Safety for pets – essentialoilvet.com/petsafety.
